title: Condon Report and its links to atomic secrecy

tellings.quote: And then you find out that he was, you know, very close friends with Oenheimer going back to, you know, their studies at Gotten in Germany in the 20s.

plain: The Condon report, the US Air Force-funded UFO study led by the physicist Edward Condon that ended in 1969, was tied to the world of atomic secrets, because Condon had been "very close friends" with J. Robert Oppenheimer, the physicist who led the atomic bomb laboratory at Los Alamos, ever since they studied in Göttingen, Germany, in the 1920s. Michels makes this case himself, without naming a source, and links it to the Los Alamos Primer, the lecture notes given to the first bomb builders, and to the McMahon Act and the Atomic Energy Act of 1954, the laws that put nuclear knowledge under strict secrecy. If true, the official UFO study was run by someone schooled in keeping nuclear secrets.
